sections.title: Fixed definitions and paired uncertainty
sections.body: The six primary comparisons are pooled-direction H15 event-weighted fast-minus-slow mean signed terminal movement in each product’s raw points. The branches use the same eligible bar/feature/calendar roster and retain their different accepted timestamps. These are observational population comparisons. Circular calendar-week blocks share sampled weeks across branches and cells, with 157 Monday weeks from 2018-01-01 through 2020-12-28, 10,000 replicates and seed 20261010. Four-week blocks are primary; one/eight-week blocks are sensitivities. Pointwise intervals have nominal 95% confidence; Bonferroni intervals target nominal 95% familywise confidence for these six primary contrasts and use exact tails .05/12 and 1−.05/12, equivalent to 99.1666667% marginal coverage. Other sides, units, sessions, metrics and horizons are descriptive. Undefined draws remain explicit; a zero-event week has no invented outcome mean. Session balancing first averages whole contributing sessions and assigns each to its trading-date Monday week. Quantiles interpolate at p(n−1). Terminal signs use strict zero; MFE>MAE ties use 1e−10×max(1,MFE,MAE). Cohorts below 100 evaluable events or 30 contributing sessions are sparse. Changing readiness and early GC support limit pooled stability claims.

sections.title: Coverage, timing and evidence qualifications
sections.body: Signals opened in New York 2018–2020 only; 2017 is causal warmup and later outcomes remain reserved. All cells use a five-minute EMA20/50 cloud, inclusive widths ES 2.4, GC 2, NQ 10 points, and independent selected-boundary states. Five-minute candles use the current completed cloud; three-minute candles use the latest scheduled completed five-minute cloud at open. This difference changes feature staleness as well as candle aggregation. Missing latest slots invalidate features immediately. The reference is unadjusted confirmed signal close, and the signal candle is excluded. Overlapping H15 observations are retained. H15 spans 45 active minutes for 3m and 75 for 5m; 60/150 active-minute and uninterrupted views are secondary. MFE/MAE and signed terminal movement describe price paths, not executable profits, fills, stops or targets. Modeled completion is available_at; original vendor receipt and mapping arrival evidence are absent. Uncertified holiday/early-close sessions are unusable and reset features. Missing minutes cannot reliably distinguish no trades from source loss. Published input bytes and inherited definitions are checked; original raw reconstruction, native TradingView equivalence and off-device backup remain uncertified. Earlier Abacus work inspected some later history, so reserved periods are not pristine market holdouts.

sections.title: Overlap and episode interpretation
sections.body: Geometry, accepted membership, union and episode pairing describe different populations. Geometry can touch both boundaries while only one stream accepts. A same-bar accepted dual has one union observation and exactly equal reference/ATR/forward paths. Different timestamps remain separate observations. The descriptive union has no combined position policy. Shared geometric episodes start on strict full-cloud departure, retain consecutive departures, and restart at a departure after any non-departure; resets terminate them. Only the first accepted event of each stream is paired. Warmup first events are retained and never replaced with later development counterparts. Later slow geometry and later accepted slow signal are separate retrospective descriptors. No later contact is false only after an observed new departure; absent contacts at resets or the endpoint remain unresolved. These labels never filter a fast signal.

sections.title: Preserved baseline and next-stage boundary
sections.body: Slow parity is checked against the immutable Stage 1 run 20261010T221954Z_s1_8c6e_r3, protocol 0.1.0-stage1.2. Its pooled H15 four-week terminal intervals included zero, and mean adverse excursion exceeded mean favorable excursion in all six cells. Negative side/session findings and block sensitivities remain retained; Stage 2 does not replace that record. The baseline input release is same_contract_ema_cloud 1.0.0. Current maintained Stage 1 verifier/caption repairs are distinct from its frozen executed source. The slow scientific parity gate precedes fast outcome execution. Stage 3 requires a separate frozen instruction; later outcomes and all gateway optimization remain reserved.

sections.title: Detailed evidence and verification
sections.body: Full saved S2-T00–S2-T10 tables, cohort/duration uncertainty, complete weekly sufficient statistics and episode metrics remain in the private research run. Numerical fixtures, exact slow parity, full scalar/path/table uncertainty reconciliation, input bytes and selected-source transfer are separately recorded. Publication validation checks selected content and assets; it does not establish research correctness.
